title: Knowledge Check 2 - Lessons 6-10
description: Questions pooled from Lessons 6-10 - Sales Lifecycle | Consulting and Implementation Strategies. Pass with 80% or higher to move toward unlocking the cert prep exam.

questions.question: A VP asks you to add a ranking that orders each open opportunity by likelihood to close so reps can sort their pipeline. Which capability fits?
questions.explanation: Only the predictive scoring model returns a likelihood ranking, while generative features produce language rather than a number.

questions.question: A team logs email manually today and now wants every Outlook message and meeting logged to Salesforce with tracking, without a fixed step sequence. Which do you choose?
questions.explanation: Salesforce Inbox augments the rep's own mailbox and calendar with logging and tracking without imposing a cadence, which is what the requirement describes.

questions.question: An admin wants forecast numbers to reflect a newly carved set of territories. Which setup is required first?
questions.explanation: Territory-based forecasting depends on Enterprise Territory Management, because without it forecasts roll up by role.

questions.question: You need one report that compares open pipeline and closed-won blocks built from different report types. Which report format do you use?
questions.explanation: A joined report combines blocks from different report types into one layout, which Tabular and the grouped formats cannot do.

questions.question: A sales leader asks for win rate by quarter, but the report currently just counts closed-won opportunities. What do you add?
options: A summary formula on the summary report
questions.explanation: Win rate is a ratio, so it needs a summary formula over the grouped rows rather than a raw count.

questions.question: Every viewer must see the same company-wide pipeline number regardless of their own record access. Which dashboard setting achieves this?
options: Run as another user (a specific user)
questions.explanation: Running the dashboard as one specific user shows that user's data scope to every viewer, while dynamic dashboards show each viewer their own scope.

questions.question: Numbers on a dashboard differ depending on who opens it, and the team wants everyone to see the same company pipeline. What do you set?
options: Run as another user (a specific user)
questions.explanation: Running as one specific user renders one shared data scope for all viewers, which is the stated goal.

questions.question: A monthly KPI email arrives with an empty report because the schedule runs as a user whose role hides the records. What is the fix?
options: Convert the report to a joined report
Set the scheduled report to run as a user with access to all the required records
questions.explanation: A scheduled report runs as the specified user, so that user must be able to see every record the report should include.

questions.question: A stakeholder wants to chart how pipeline coverage changed over a year, but the live report shows only current values. Which feature do you use?
questions.explanation: A reporting snapshot writes report results into a custom object over time, which is what lets you chart change the live report cannot show.

questions.question: Your sponsor asks when success metrics for an Agentforce sales rollout should be defined. What do you advise?
options: After go-live, once real usage data exists
During user acceptance testing, once configuration is frozen
Prior to implementation, with the business, as part of the readiness assessment
Only if the project runs over budget
questions.explanation: Metrics must be set prior to implementation so there is an unbiased baseline, and they are agreed with the business rather than with the build team alone.

questions.question: A sales user keeps forgetting which field to update on the new record page. Which training mechanism puts the instruction where they are already looking?
options: A printed job aid left at the desk
An in-app guidance prompt on the record page
A change set containing the field
questions.explanation: In-app guidance renders on the page the user is viewing, which solves the last mile that classroom training and job aids lose over time.

questions.question: A program has an executive sponsor and a detailed communication plan, yet adoption stalls in week two. Which readiness element was most likely missing?
options: User champions from the most affected group involved in design
questions.explanation: An executive sponsor without user champions from the most affected group involved in design stalls once the sponsor stops repeating the message, which readiness assessment exists to catch.

questions.question: The sponsor reports that logins are up but the business sees no improvement. Which measurement choice explains the gap?
options: Reporting vanity metrics such as logins instead of outcome metrics
Asking the sponsor to estimate the benefit
questions.explanation: Logins count presence rather than behavior or business result, so a report built on vanity metrics such as logins cannot show that anything improved.

questions.question: You have one Full sandbox, and integration and UAT both need it. Which sandbox should carry end-user training?
options: A Developer sandbox, because it refreshes daily
The Full Copy sandbox, shared with UAT
A Partial Copy sandbox, because it copies metadata plus template-sampled data with a 5 day refresh
questions.explanation: Partial Copy gives metadata and template-sampled data at 5 GB with a 5-day refresh, so it trains users on realistic records without consuming the single Full sandbox the other phases need.

questions.question: Four weeks after go-live, usage slips among the reps who were trained in week one. Which action is most likely to restore it?
options: Deploy in-app guidance prompts on the high friction pages
Send a reminder email to the whole sales team
Extend the original instructor-led course by another day
questions.explanation: In-app guidance prompts on the high friction pages put the instruction back on the page where the work happens, which addresses decayed training without another calendar-heavy session.
